name: @kealthas-dev/opencode-llm-review-gate
description: llm-review-gate.ts opencode plugin (gates bash tool calls behind an LLM safety review before they run), published to npm so opencode's own npm-plugin loader can install it directly from a bare package name in opencode.json's plugin array - see CLAUDE.md. Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type. Independently installable from hook-logger.ts - not bundled together.
